rationale: C20 plausibly supplied a material template for temporarily assigning an official's duties during incapacity. Its operative formula—an identified officer shall “perform the duties” when the officeholder is absent, sick, or under disability—closely parallels the child's authorization to “perform and discharge the duties” of a judge during “absence, illness, or other legal disability.” C03 has weaker overlaps in designation and uncompensated service, while C24's title suggests analogous acting-secretary machinery but its supplied text contains no operative language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: to perform and discharge the duties of Judge ... during the absence, illness, or other legal disability of the Judge thereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In case of the absence, sickness ... or ... disability to discharge the duties of the office ... shall perform the duties of that office
shared_material.explanation: The directives share both a close sequence of incapacity conditions and the same temporary-duty assignment mechanism.
